integrity: Two independently implemented exhaustive enumerations plus an independent affine-orbit classification certificate were executed from the included files; standalone program texts and outputs are embedded. Publication priority is a bounded-search judgement and no independent external audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The classification is exhaustive only for the Pappus graph and cardinalities six and eight under single-vertex replacement (token jumping). Exhaustive finite code, not a general theorem for arbitrary affine-plane orders. Unindexed equivalent published results remain a priority risk.
title: Nine line-graph phases of eight-vertex paired domination on the Pappus graph
